findings.description: The condition uses all() where the docstring says "if at least one is documented", so it should be any(). With all(), the section is printed only when every argument has help.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with two arguments, only one of which has help. all() returns False, so the whole "Positional arguments" section is dropped and the documented argument disappears from --help. Separately, a command with no arguments makes all() on an empty list True, so an empty "Positional arguments" section is written with a heading and no entries, and write_dl([]) may fail or print a stray header.
